item.title: Version 1.3.0-beta (85)
item.description:
Trails RG Studio 1.3.0-beta

Build 85

  • The preview cache stays within 2 GB, so browsing a large drive does not fill the Mac
  • Find duplicates reads less of each file and finishes sooner
  • Cull and Find unusable read several photos at once, sized to this computer, and keep reading the next group while the current one is scored
